summary.text: Wayne McMahen is a Republican member of the Louisiana House of Representatives for District 10, which covers Bossier and Webster parishes, and was first elected in 2018. His official House page lists him as Vice Chair of the Health and Welfare Committee.

paragraphs.text: The House page lists McMahen's occupation as retired veterinarian at McMahen Veterinary Hospital and director of Citizens National Bank.
It lists his education as a B.S. in pre-veterinary medicine from Louisiana Tech University and a Doctor of Veterinary Medicine degree from Louisiana State University.
He is also listed as a member of the Agriculture, Forestry, Aquaculture, and Rural Development and Ways and Means committees.
